language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.
language.lessonRating: How do you feel about this exercise?

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Aloha, friends! Welcome to Hawaii! My name is Hannah and this is our friend, Tiki Todd. He owns this Tiki Hut on the beach by my house. He sells all sorts of fun snacks and delicious juices. Maybe we’ll get to taste some later!

Speaking of tasting, I thought it might be fun today to explore the beach and the Tiki Hut. Let's do that by using our 5 senses. We can use our eyes to see everything around us, our ears to hear everything, our noses to smell things, our mouths to taste yummy treats, and our hands to feel different items. What do you say? Would you like to help me?
That would be super! Mahalo! That means thank you in Hawaiian.
Let's get started!

exercises.title: Do You Hear What I Hear?

dialog.text: When I go to the beach, I love to be quiet and listen to all of the neat sounds around me. There are at least 5 things here that make noise. Do you think you could help me hear where the sounds are coming from?

helperSimple.text: For each question, click on the correct part of the picture.
